## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user problem, roles affected, and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List checks run and what they establish. Distinguish mocked, database, provider, and browser evidence.

## Data/configuration changes

Describe migrations, index changes, new environment settings, and rollback considerations, or state none.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Documentation and examples match the implementation.
- [ ] Authorization and ownership behavior were reviewed where affected.
- [ ] No credentials, generated passwords, or patient information are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests/build pass, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Breaking changes and remaining risks are stated.
